name: Análisis Espectral de Nyquist
description: Analiza the frequency espectro at Nyquist boundaries para detectar upsampling artefactos. AI models often produce anomalous spectral peaks at these frequencies that are absent in real photographs, caused by upsampling operations in red neuronal architectures.
mechanism:
The análisis process involves several stages:

1. **2D FFT Transform**: Converts the image from dominio espacial to dominio de frecuencia using 2D Fast Fourier Transform.

2. **High-frequency espectro análisis**: Examina spectral energy around the Nyquist frequency (f/2). Neural network image generators (GANs, Diffusion models) use upsampling layers (bilinear, nearest-neighbor, transposed convolution) that create characteristic frequency artefactos.

3. **Periodic peak detección**: Identifica periodic energy peaks in the frequency espectro — a hallmark signature of upsampling in decoder/generator architectures.

4. **Spectral comparison**: Compara the frequency energy distribución against natural spectral models. Camera images have natural high-frequency rolloff due to optics, while AI images show abnormal energy distribucións.
parameters:
Transform: 2D FFT (radix-2), Analysis region: Nyquist band ±10%, Metrics: high/low frequency energy ratio, periodic peak coeficiente, spectral gradiente

Analysis size: full image + 256x256 blocks
Normalization: logarithmic espectro, azimuthal averaging
accuracy: Alta - 80-90% for AI images with upsampling artefactos. Particularly effective for GAN-generated images (StyleGAN, ProGAN) due to heavy use of upsampling layers.
source: Durall et al. (2020) Watch your Up-Convolution, CVPR 2020
useCase: Detección de artefactos de frecuencia de redes generativas y sobremuestreo. Especialmente efectivo con imágenes GAN e imágenes escaladas por IA.

references.title: Zhang, X. et al. (2019). Detecting and Simulating Artifacts in GAN Fake Images. IEEE WIFS.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Deep Neural Networks are Failing to Reproduce Spectral Distributions. CVPR.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Dzanic, T. et al. (2020). Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images. NeurIPS.

strengths:
• Effectively detecta GAN-specific upsampling artefactos
• Content-independent análisis
• Difficult to forge as it relates to fundamental frequency characteristics
• Works well with uncompressed or lightly compressed images
limitations:
• Effectiveness decreases with heavy compresión JPEG
• Some newer Diffusion models produce fewer spectral artefactos
• Real images that have been resized may produce falsos positivos
• Not effective with small images (< 256x256)
